main_body: Tall two-door wardrobe: a cornice panel at the top, two inset-looking doors with yellow handles, and a base band.
top_band: rows 1-4 (L~127, #b77246) are the same tone as the door face (L~130). A single highlight row at row 5 (L=157) is followed by rows 6-7 and a dark band at rows 8-9. There is no lighter horizontal surface.
evidence: The upper rows 1-4 stay in the same lightness family as the front below (127 vs 130, a difference far under 25 L), so they count as part of the front face and not as a top. The 1-row highlight at row 5 is only an edge line, and the dark band at rows 8-9 is a cornice shadow. Together they make a cornice with doors, drawn in a flat architectural elevation. No horizontal top surface is visible from above, so this matches the red 'front elevation' guide case.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 10 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and 9 colours per tile against 17-20. 100% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, which gives a black sticker-like outline instead of a dark material tone. The shading is limited to about 4 brown steps, with large door panels carrying a single tone. It has no flat-fill blocks (0%), but the texture is sparse, and next to the stall and well it looks thinner and flatter.
